attributes.action: Move Sealink & Lion link to brown field sites, following Dunwich Heath Fire
attributes.additional_details: The devastating Dunwich Heath fire has destroyed one of our most precious wildlife habitats, making it more important than ever to protect what remains of the Suffolk Coast. We call on the Government to relocate LionLink and SeaLink landfalls and associated infrastructure to suitable brownfield sites. Both schemes would pass through or beside protected nature reserves, adding to the impacts of Sizewell C on wildlife, landscape and communities already struggling with major construction works.
attributes.background: The Dunwich Heath fire has devastated a vital coastal nature reserve, compounding the impact of Sizewell C on Suffolk's wildlife and communities. Following this fire, we call on the Government to move LionLink and SeaLink to brownfield sites outside the Suffolk Coast Area Outstanding Natural Beauty.

rejection.details:
We can’t accept petitions that call for actions relating to a local area. 

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
